status.beyondsolo.title: TITLE
status.beyondsolo.unevaluated.desc: The System cannot read you yet. Find a village and touch the crystal in its Evaluation Zone.
stat.beyondsolo.str.desc: Strength. More melee damage, harder crits and less knockback.
stat.beyondsolo.agi.desc: Agility. Faster movement and attacks, dodge chance and quicker bow draw.
stat.beyondsolo.vit.desc: Vitality. More max health, natural armor and toughness, better healing and faster fatigue recovery.
stat.beyondsolo.int.desc: Intelligence. More max mana, faster mana regen and shorter cooldowns.
stat.beyondsolo.sense.desc: Sense. Crit chance, luck and reach.
objective.beyondsolo.find_village.desc: You woke up somewhere unknown. Find a village to learn what happened to you.
objective.beyondsolo.find_evaluation_zon: Find the Evaluation Zone in this village and touch the crystal to receive your rank and class.
log.beyondsolo.hint: hides the pop-ups on screen, or brings the latest back
hud.beyondsolo.collapsed.hint: Your body won't move. Sleep or wait it out.
notify.beyondsolo.welcome.title: Welcome, Player.
notify.beyondsolo.welcome.body: You have been chosen. The System will awaken once you are evaluated.
notify.beyondsolo.scan.title: Scanning...
notify.beyondsolo.scan_interrupted.title: Evaluation interrupted
notify.beyondsolo.scan_interrupted.body: You moved too far from the crystal.
notify.beyondsolo.evaluated.title: Evaluation complete
notify.beyondsolo.system_online.title: The System is now active
notify.beyondsolo.system_online.body: Press [%s] to open your Status window. Press [%s] to hide or bring back these messages.
notify.beyondsolo.level_up.title: Level Up!
notify.beyondsolo.level_up.body: You reached level %s. Unspent stat points: %s
notify.beyondsolo.exhaustion_warning.bod: Rest now, or your body will give out.
notify.beyondsolo.collapse.title: You collapsed
notify.beyondsolo.collapse.body: Your body has reached its limit. You can't move for %s seconds.
notify.beyondsolo.recovered.title: Recovered
